name: Universal Solvent
summary: A liquid that dissolves any adhesive, including Sovereign Glue.

stats.effect:
This tube holds milky liquid with a strong alcohol smell. When found, a tube contains 1d6 + 1 ounces.

You can take a Utilize action to pour 1 or more ounces of solvent from the tube onto a surface within reach. Each ounce instantly dissolves up to 1 square foot of adhesive it touches, including *{ref:magic-item/sovereign-glue}*.
